answer_1.quote: GPT-4o was used to produce machine-generated news articles and short messages for both true and fake categories, paraphrasing the original text using five different prompts... Each example is generated with one prompt randomly sampled from the five, using OpenAI batch generation.
datasets: Machine-generated Urdu news derived from Ax-to-Grind, UFN2023, UFN Augmented Corpus, Bend the Truth
answer_1.outputs: machine-generated Urdu news articles and headlines (paraphrased versions of human-written content)

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 1,008 examples... and had three native Urdu speakers review the articles. They compared machine text with original articles and found that 9% of samples had minor discrepancies, generally introducing additional context.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compared machine-generated text with the original articles and flagged any factual errors, hallucinations, or significant token-length differences.
